notes: R1 names the run ID that the first case returns. Stand-in ports: the stage transport settles each prompted stage with a valid handoff unless a case says otherwise; GitHub resolves issue 17 in example/project with default branch main. Expected values come from the prompt, not from running the module.

cases.given: Source checkout with one untracked file of the person's own. Bundled small-change definition. No run exists for issue 17.
effects: run snapshot with full guide bytes exists before allocateIssueWorktree is called
exactly one agent stage started (scope), with cwd equal to the assigned worktree
the scope stage is accepted and its backend closed once
source checkout files and git status unchanged

cases.given: R1 waits at change; no pending work.
R1 waits at change. The change and verify stages write valid handoffs; the pinned test argv exits 0 and changes nothing.
effects: the scope proposal is pinned before change starts
agent stages change and verify each started exactly once
the runner itself runs the pinned test argv once, without a shell
exactly one push and one PR create, after the PR intent is saved

cases.given: R1 waits at wait-merge. GitHub shows the saved PR number and URL merged with the saved head and a 40-digit lowercase merge commit.
The same refusal applies to any decision other than approve or skip, such as reject.

effects: no snapshot, worktree or journal created

cases.given: R1 (agent claude) waits at change with no pending work; its controller has exited.
The controller of R1 is still running its first stage.
effects: exactly one worktree add in total

cases.given: No run has ID 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000; lookup reports recovery_required.
effects: no journal directory created for that ID
a later genuine run for issue 17 still starts

cases.given: R1 waits at change; no pending work.
A feature run waits at the human stage approve with a recorded proposal (prompt, Story, cases and test argv).
A feature run at the optional PR stage prompt-pr. The journal ends right after the saved skip choice for prompt-pr. The build stage transport reports blocked.
effects: build has no merge-ancestry requirement because its merge was skipped

cases.given: A feature run at the optional stage visual. A saved approve choice exists for visual, with the current fingerprint, and no attempt was saved.
The scope delivery returned recovery_required after a prompt_intent checkpoint; the run returned recovery_required. Inspection still reports recovery_required.
effects: inspectHerdrStage called with the original attempt ID

cases.given: The scope attempt is saved in phase start_intent; agent setup blocked before the first prompt. The person finished setup, and the same agent is now ready.
effects: runHerdrStage called with the saved attempt ID, context, request bytes and backend
exactly one prompt delivered for scope in total
the accepted scope backend keeps the original terminal identity
change not started, because the next-advance proposal was recorded in this command

cases.given: The scope attempt is saved in phase start_intent, but its saved request bytes no longer give the saved prompt digest.
The scope stage is accepted; the close reply was lost and the backend phase is close_intent.
The open-pr intent was saved, push succeeded and PR 23 was created, but the create reply was lost; that command returned recovery_required.
effects: no further push, no further PR create

cases.given: R1 waits at change. The change stage writes valid files with a wrong value; the pinned test argv exits 1.
effects: test results with a nonzero exit code are saved

cases.given: R1 waits at change. The pinned test exits 0 but rewrites a tracked source file.
R1 waits at change. The change stage also edits the pinned cases file.
R1 waits at change. The person edits a tracked file in the assigned worktree.
A project workflow with a report stage after verify and before a verified PR stage. Verify passed; the report stage then committed a source change.
effects: the earlier verify results stay saved

cases.given: R1 waits at wait-merge with PR 23 saved. GitHub now shows PR 24 with the same marker, branch, base and head, merged.
R1 waits at wait-merge. GitHub shows the saved PR 23 closed without merge.
effects: no push, no PR create, no merge command

cases.given: A feature run recorded the prompt-merge commit. The assigned branch does not contain that commit, and the worktree is unchanged.
A feature run has an uncertain build attempt after prompt-merge was recorded. The person then commits a new change on the assigned branch.
The scope agent settled while the person was attached; the controller returned waiting without acceptance. The person has detached.
effects: first resume: candidate dropped, no close
second resume: the same attempt validated afresh and closed once
one agent stage started in total

cases.given: R1 waits at change; the scope backend is closed and no attempt is pending.
A project workflow run waits at its work stage. The person then edits that stage's Markdown in the source checkout.
effects: saved stage context still holds the original Markdown

cases.given: R1's journal ends with a partial row and no final newline.
Issues 21 to 25 each start a small-change run; each first stage delivery returns recovery_required.
effects: five distinct run IDs and five distinct worktrees
resuming one of them, with or without approve, starts no stage
